claimBoundary.whyParameterSpaceIsDiagnostic: The five proportional factors are pre-score construction points, not inferred physical corrections or bounds. Every point is reported; none may be selected after seeing residuals and presented as a measured conversion.

sourceProtocol.geometry: polyhedral crystals smaller than 300 micrometres on a growth substrate; selected c-to-a ratio 0.6 to 3.0
sourceProtocol.forcing: fixed temperature and source-plotted apparatus supersaturation calibrated from each experiment's evaporation point; the paper does not identify this coordinate as facet-local surface supersaturation
sourceProtocol.transport: the source treats vapor diffusion and latent-heat resistance as ignorable under its protocol; this Phase 9 protocol does not convert that source judgment into an exact surface-value identity
sourceProtocol.ensemble: unreported per-series specimen count; one crystal in the microscope field during a measurement
sourceProtocol.observable: facet-normal growth rate in micrometres per second
sourceProtocol.rights: source PDF remains NAS-local; tracked normalized rows are the already accepted Phase 8 digitization metadata and bindings

mappingFamily.reason: the required source-specific geometry and transport closure is absent

modelOperators.sharedRateLaw: normal rate equals the Hertz-Knudsen attachment coefficient times kinetic velocity times local surface supersaturation
modelOperators.kineticVelocity: core/src/libbrecht.ts vKin central closed form, shared by M-F and M-K2 so the annex comparison changes no kinetic-velocity convention

mfBroadCak.mapping: bounded replay of the inherited permanent LibbrechtKinetics CAK control in core/src/libbrecht.ts; its monograph Figure 4.5 digitizations are not treated as newly source-cleared or current Phase 9 inputs
mfBroadCak.inputUncertainty: the source mapping records plus or minus 25 percent relative barrier and plus or minus 0.03 absolute prism prefactor digitization uncertainty; the v1 point prediction interval propagates only plot-coordinate digitization and therefore remains explicitly incomplete

mk2PrismAnnex.basalPolicy: unchanged inherited CAK control at minus seven and minus fifteen Celsius
mk2PrismAnnex.curvaturePolicy: zero-curvature planar form only; the complete FACET curvature relation is not claimed
mk2PrismAnnex.minusThirtyPolicy: hard refusal: the annex prints no minus thirty Celsius row and no extrapolation is permitted
mk2PrismAnnex.inputUncertainty: the paper calls higher-temperature details uncertain but prints no numeric branch-parameter uncertainty; absence is retained rather than treated as zero

zeroGrowthControl.purpose: type-appropriate nontriviality control for M-F; it is not a physical rival

rawToAlignedTransform.rawRows: remain in the six hash-pinned NAS JSONL artifacts
rawToAlignedTransform.coordinateConversion: retain source-plotted apparatus supersaturation percent, then divide by 100 and multiply by the exact registered diagnostic factor; none of the five points is an identified physical conversion
rawToAlignedTransform.rateConversion: none; rows and predictions are micrometres per second
rawToAlignedTransform.interpolation: none across observed rows; evaluate each model at each retained central coordinate and its digitization endpoints
rawToAlignedTransform.duplicatePolicy: point identifiers must be unique within a series; no row is dropped or averaged
rawToAlignedTransform.negativeUncertaintyEndpoint: retain the digitized endpoint; the no-sublimation rate law returns zero at nonpositive mapped drive rather than silently shifting the interval
rawToAlignedTransform.fitting: none; diagnostic factors are a fully reported pre-score construction grid and are never optimized

score.pointCentralLoss: squared residual in squared micrometres per squared second
score.pointIntervalLoss: squared minimum gap between the coordinate-induced prediction interval and the retained digitized observation interval; zero means overlap, not agreement within statistical uncertainty
score.seriesLoss: arithmetic mean over retained points within one series
score.familyLoss: arithmetic mean of per-series losses; pooled point loss is forbidden
score.mfRoster: all six series with equal series weight
score.ablation: inherited permanent CAK control on the exact two matched prism series
score.basalIdentityControl: M-K2 basal predictions must be bit-identical to M-F at every evaluated mapped coordinate
score.mfNontrivialityControl: zero-growth-control over the exact six M-F series
score.expectedMk2Effect: strictly lower central MSE on both matched prism series, lower equal-series central MSE, and no higher equal-series interval-gap MSE than M-F under the same mapping
score.noEffectBranch: any mapping that misses one of those conditions is a diagnostic no-pass at that mapping
score.physicalDecision: always unavailable in v1 because the apparatus-to-surface mapping is source-blocked, model uncertainty is incomplete, and the inherited CAK monograph edition/extraction gap remains unresolved
score.stopRule: stop morphology interpretation for every v1 outcome; a later physical score requires a new frozen mapping and uncertainty decision before its output is inspected
